question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** "excellent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Excellent" **means extremely good or outstanding. (बहुत बढ़िया; उच्‍च स्‍तर का, उत्‍कृष्‍ट)

 
 
• **Example**:* The food at that restaurant was **excellent**__.*
 
 
 
• It is an adjective that describes the quality of something.
 
• The word can be used to describe a person, thing, or experience.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

Nainital has a __beautiful__ lake. Tourists come from far and wide to __enjoy__ boating here. There is a skating place behind it. People who skate here say that the ride seems to go round with them. Evenings are also pleasant here. The __reflection__ of the electric lights looks as if they are dancing in the ripples of the lake. Truly, Nainital is an __**excellent**__ city of ______ 5 ______ beauty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "opulent",** means luxurious or wealthy. (महंगी वस्तुओं से सजा; भव्य; शानदार)
 
• **Option 2, "irritating", **means causing annoyance or frustration. (झुंझलाहट या निराशा पैदा करना)
 
• **Option 3, "ominous",** means giving the impression that something bad is going to happen. (अशुभसूचक)
